entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-06
entry.content:
Issues

  • Incorrect state for some structs after being created with arguments #81892

  • `await` completion inserts using directive for `System.Threading.Tasks` even if is already imported globally #81880
